\maketitle

This archive keeps the exhaustive view of the exploration summarized in the appendices of the working paper: every trained configuration, including negative results and runs that failed numerically, the asset sets that define pairing, and the figures covering whole campaigns. Accuracy is the final record of each run, without best-epoch selection; means and sample standard deviations are over valid seeds, and a single-seed configuration has no SD. Runs are paired only within matching asset sets and run conditions. The test set was used repeatedly, so these numbers are exploratory. Numbers come from the audited experiment index on branch \texttt{benchmark-organized} at commit \texttt{\benchCommit} ($\idxExperiments$ experiments, $\idxConfigurations$ configurations, $\idxRuns$ runs); per-output provenance is in \texttt{paper/provenance/generated\_assets.json}.

\section{Resolution-only batch}
This batch contains $\rbNConfigs$ targeted configurations with three seeds each, not a full factorial design: seven operators at the input and after block 1, max-pooling at five locations, four schedules for three operators after block 1, a plain arm and two fixed-resolution controls. Resolution-only means without an additional Gaussian continuation; smoothing built into an operator is part of the operator.
